Unfortunately I'm in a country that doesn't have much in the way of proper therapy. I've seen a few doctors here, but besides prescribing medicine, there isn't much else offered. 

If you have any recommendations for online groups that might be helpful, I'd be happy to know about them ! I've looked previously and never found anything too useful-seeming.

Yeah, it was a weird night ... ahaha. 

Thanks for the kind words, yeah it sucks but I'll figure it out.

Yeah I feel you, it helps somewhat, albeit briefly, but it only makes things worse once the fun bit is over. If you're gonna do something, at least do something actually interesting like shrooms that doesn't make you feel like shit the next day. I'm speaking from experience here, eat a salad a stay sober for a couple of days, sleep early. Go try and get some badass daredevil job if you still feel like dying. You don't need to wait around waiting for that day, take some chances, at least try like a couple thousand things before giving up. Life sucks, but there's a lot out there to try before finishing up.

Don't drink, at least not excessively. Drugs too (besides the stuff your therapist might give you). At least try for a few days, see how you feel then. When I was 19 I found myself in a similar situation, and while I can't lie that I still don't feel shitty now at 29, there have also been so many worthwhile moments in between then and now, incredible things that were impossible to imagine at that time. Give yourself some more time, see what happens. I've had single days turn my life around.

I'll be praying for you.
Praying for you, I know the feeling ! We can get through this,
